about: Looks at Forgejo Actions runs and at files in a folder of a student's own repository (the fork), as the Forgejo admin. Reads only. `repo` must be the checking student's own ({user}/...); the runner refuses anything else, and so do these verbs.

ci_run.does: among the repository's last 150 Actions runs of the workflow file (e.g. pr.yml), optionally only those started by event (push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch): some run finished with status (success, the default, or failure); latest: true judges only the newest finished run; recovered: true, the newest finished run succeeded and an older one failed

tree_file_contains.does: some file directly in dir on ref whose name matches name_regex (default any) matches every regex in regex (a string or a list, multiline) and, with count_regex, has at least count_min (default 1) matches of it; at most 40 files are read
